claim_ceiling: Synthetic campaign plan only. No DAS raw traces, validated optical interrogator model, published-paper reproduction, operational fibre integration or tamper-detection performance.

scenarios.name: Direct-buried coupled fibre with seeded periodic event
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Independent trigger and surveyed chainage agree with the event report within frozen tolerance; record SNR and latency.

scenarios.name: Conduit-installed fibre with interface damping
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose reduced observability and do not transfer direct-burial sensitivity to conduit installation.

scenarios.name: Shared-trench adjacent cable event
conditions: fibre and target cable in shared trench
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not assert cable fault origin from chainage alone; require independent classification and route separation evidence.

scenarios.name: No event on an unobservable segment
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve the section as unobserved or unobservable; missing signal is not proof of no event.

scenarios.name: Periodic electrical transient in controlled fixture
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Independent trigger confirms periodicity; alert remains advisory and cannot operate protection.

scenarios.name: Clock or interrogator configuration mismatch
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject incompatible configuration; do not silently repair timing or interrogator metadata.

scenarios.name: Traffic-induced route geolocation with surveyed truth
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report cross-track and along-route errors separately; compare against independent survey truth.

scenarios.name: Wrong route endpoint or direction
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject geographic placement; chainage may be reported only relative to unresolved endpoint.

scenarios.name: Multiple plausible route alignments
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Retain alternative alignments; no single high-confidence geometry until independently disambiguated.

scenarios.name: Fibre geometry changed after repair
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Supersede old calibration and bind placements to new exact as-built evidence.

scenarios.name: Benign traffic vs roadworks-like vibration
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not claim tamper classification until independent labels and class-specific metrics exist.

scenarios.name: Rainfall and water-flow confounder
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose environmental confounding; abstain outside the declared classifier profile.

scenarios.name: Interrogator outage and partial channel loss
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Account for missing length/time; no global coverage claim during outage.

scenarios.name: Known chainage but missing geographic datum
conditions: no compatible CRS or surveyed tie points
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report fibre-relative chainage only; no geographic coordinate without versioned transform and uncertainty.

global_controls: DAS event chainage and geographic fibre location are distinct claims.
Fault/event screening and route geolocalization are separate populations.
Direct burial and conduit coupling must be separate strata.
Missing DAS event is not proof of no event where observability is absent.
Every result binds fibre revision, interrogator, calibration, gauge length, sample rate, clock and route model.
Operational fibre tests require owner approval and a non-interference plan.
DAS alerts cannot authorize protection, isolation, dispatch, excavation or repair.
Tamper detection remains a hypothesis until an independent labelled corpus exists.
